```{r}
# Load Packages
library(terra) # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(spData) # spatial data
library(spDataLarge) # spatial data
library(stars)
```


```{r}
# Load data
depth <- rast("EDS223-HW3/data/depth.tif")
sst_2008 <- rast("EDS223-HW3/data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif")
sst_2009 <- rast("EDS223-HW3/data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif")
sst_2010 <- rast("EDS223-HW3/data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif")
sst_2011 <- rast("EDS223-HW3/data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif")
sst_2012 <- rast("EDS223-HW3/data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif")
wc_regions <- st_read("EDS223-HW3/data/wc_regions_clean.shp")
```


```{r}
# Combine sea surface temperature files

#Check that crs match
print(same.crs(sst_2008, sst_2009))
print(same.crs(sst_2008,sst_2010))
print(same.crs(sst_2008, sst_2011))
print(same.crs(sst_2008, sst_2012))

# Combine files
sst_multiyear <- c(sst_2008, sst_2009, sst_2010, sst_2011, sst_2012)

# Take 4-year mean value of each cell
sst_mean_kel <- mean(sst_multiyear, na.rm = TRUE) 

# Convert to Celsius
sst_mean_c <- sst_mean_kel - 273.15

#crop depth raster to match the extent of the SST raster
#note: the resolutions of the SST and depth data do not match
#resample the depth data to match the resolution of the SST data using the bilinear method approach
#check that the depth and SST match in resolution, extent, and coordinate reference system
#hint: can the rasters be stacked?

#Resample the depth data to match the resolution of the SST data using the bilinear method approach
depth_resampled <- resample(depth, sst_mean_c, method = "bilinear")

# Crop depth data to sst data
depth_cropped <- crop(depth_resampled, sst_mean_c)

#Confirm that crs match
same.crs(sst_mean_c, depth_resampled)

#Confirm resolutions, extents, and crs match
print(ext(depth_cropped) == ext(sst_mean_c))
print(same.crs(depth_cropped, sst_mean_c))
print(res(depth_cropped) == res(sst_mean_c))
```
